strategies.summary: In seek-and-destroy consolidation, buy only from the discount-discount edge of the dealing range after a sell-side sweep closes back above the swept low and an ST model forms. Take the conservative target near range equilibrium because these conditions are mean-reverting.

timeframes.notes: Daily anchors the dealing range; setup and entry execute on 5m. Written on the canonical bullish side, while premium-premium shorts are the mirror.

glossary.Discount discount: The bullish outer quarter of the dealing range where longs are sought; see custom_signals.quadrant_extreme.
glossary.Premium premium: The bearish mirror of discount discount: the upper quarter of the dealing range where shorts are sought.

custom_signals.name: dealing_range
custom_signals.plain_definition: A price range whose low swept the prior swing low (sell-side) and whose high swept the prior swing high (buy-side).

custom_signals.name: dealing_range_high
custom_signals.plain_definition: The high of the current dealing range.

custom_signals.name: dealing_range_low
custom_signals.plain_definition: The low of the current dealing range.

custom_signals.name: quadrant_extreme
custom_signals.plain_definition: Price reaches the lowest quarter of the established range (0 to 0.25, discount of discount) for longs.

custom_signals.name: pure_sweep
custom_signals.plain_definition: Price trades through a swing low (sell-side liquidity) and the sweeping candle closes back above it (turtle soup).

custom_signals.name: st_model
custom_signals.plain_definition: Displacement, retracement, displacement: a first FVG forms, price retraces into it without closing through it, then a second same-direction FVG forms; entry is on the second.
custom_signals.numeric_definition: bullish_fvg[0].formed AND bullish_fvg[1].confirmed_at >= open_time - K_ST_MAX_CANDLES * (tf_minutes * 60000) AND lowest(low[-1], (open_time - bullish_fvg[1].confirmed_at) / (tf_minutes * 60000) - 1) <= bullish_fvg[1].gap_high AND NOT bullish_fvg[1].filled

custom_signals.name: intermediate_term_low
custom_signals.plain_definition: A swing low flanked by a higher swing low on its left and a higher swing low on its right.

sequence: Confirm that price is trading inside a dealing range.
Wait for price to reach the discount-discount edge of that range.
Require a sell-side sweep that closes back above the swept low.
Buy the ST model retracement and target nearby equilibrium.

invalidation.text: Once equilibrium is reached, everything is invalidated. Do not look for new entries until a new quadrant extreme is hit.

filters.text: Do not expect price to run very far; use a close, easy target as price will likely return to your entry.
Wait for a failure to follow through to confirm a new range if the old one is broken.

entry_rule.text: Enter on the retracement into the second bullish fair value gap / overlapping PD array left by the ST model.
entry_rule.quote: enter on an overlapping PD array right there covering the intermediate term high

target_rule.text: Target the nearest opposing liquidity pool or fair value gap around the 50% equilibrium of the dealing range.
target_rule.quote: Target a liquidity pull again close to equilibrium of the range that you are trading in

stop_rule.text: Place the stop beyond the intermediate-term low and give it room to breathe.
stop_rule.quote: you would not suffocate your stop loss that is very important don't suffocate your stop loss give it some room to breathe

management.notes: Get in and get out; expect price to likely return to entry if held too long.

presenter_claims.claim: A 1.75 or 1:2 RR is a great result in Seek and Destroy conditions and you should be content with it.

strategies.notes: Mean-reversion framework, not a trend-following model. The range condition is proxied by custom_signals.dealing_range and the turtle soup itself by custom_signals.pure_sweep. Written on the bullish side; the first example is the bearish premium-premium mirror. The presenter says the target should stay close because price often returns to the entry in consolidation.

uncertainties.issue: How a broken range becomes a new valid dealing range
uncertainties.why: The presenter says to wait for failure to follow through after a break, but gives no exact threshold for when the old range is abandoned and the new one is confirmed.

confidence.reason: Clear step-by-step sequence dictated directly by the presenter.

strategies.summary: With a higher-timeframe draw on liquidity in view, wait for a lower-timeframe sell-side sweep into the setup PD array during London or New York AM. Enter on strength above the sweep candle and hold toward the opposing 4h swing.

timeframes.notes: 4h supplies the directional draw on liquidity, the 1h setup chart carries the array context, and 5m supplies the sweep-and-stop-order trigger. Written on the canonical bullish side.

glossary.Buying on strength: Placing a buy stop order just above the high of the specific down-candle that swept the liquidity low.
glossary.Selling on weakness: Placing a sell stop order just below the low of the specific up-candle that swept the liquidity high.

custom_signals.name: htf_pd_array_tap
custom_signals.plain_definition: Price trades into a higher-timeframe discount array (bullish) or premium array (bearish), such as a fair value gap or order block.
custom_signals.numeric_definition: (low <= bullish_fvg[0].gap_high@bias_tf AND high >= bullish_fvg[0].gap_low@bias_tf AND NOT bullish_fvg[0].filled@bias_tf) OR (low <= bullish_ob[0].zone_high@bias_tf AND high >= bullish_ob[0].zone_low@bias_tf AND NOT bullish_ob[0].invalidated@bias_tf)

custom_signals.name: pure_sweep
custom_signals.plain_definition: Price trades through a swing low (sell-side liquidity) and the sweeping candle closes back above it (turtle soup).

sequence: Keep the 4h draw on liquidity in view and wait for price to trade into the setup PD array.
During London or New York AM, require a sell-side sweep on 5m that closes back above the swept low.
Place a buy stop above the sweep candle and hold for the opposing 4h swing high.

invalidation.text: If time (the killzone) does not align with the sweep into the discount array, there is no entry opportunity.

filters.text: A LTF swing extreme inside a HTF FVG has very slim odds of holding; anticipate it being swept.
Turtle soups can satisfy the ego by calling tops/bottoms, but they are not always the highest probability setups.

entry_rule.text: Place a buy stop above the high of the candle responsible for sweeping the sell-side liquidity low.
entry_rule.quote: buying on strength you want to enter above the candle that was responsible for sweeping that low

target_rule.text: Target the opposing 4h liquidity objective, typically the swing high above price.
target_rule.quote: the discount rate that you're targeting then is a swing low on a four hour basis

stop_rule.text: Place the stop below the sweep candle low with enough room to breathe; the quoted pip/point sizes are market-specific examples only.
stop_rule.quote: on Forex it's like a 20 30 pip stop loss on ES right here I would argue all right maybe an 8 to 10 pip

presenter_claims.claim: Turtle soups look fancy and satisfy the ego, but are not the highest probability entries and don't give the best RR compared to waiting.

strategies.notes: Trend-following turtle soup. The session timing is expressed with requires_context.session because the presenter names only the standard London and New York AM kill zones. The turtle soup itself is custom_signals.pure_sweep: the sweep must close back above the swept low. The market-specific pip and point numbers remain in the text and quote; the machine stop uses the sweep-candle extreme plus K_STOP_BUFFER_ATR as a structural proxy for 'room to breathe'.

confidence.reason: Explicit entry criteria ('buying on strength') outlined clearly with concrete stop-loss examples.

fvgs.presenter_calls_it: overlapping PD array / fair value gap

annotations_drawn_by_presenter.meaning: Fibonacci tool dividing the range into quartiles (0.25, 0.5, 0.75) to find premium premium.

setup_walkthrough.what_happens: Price reaches the premium premium zone of the established Seek and Destroy range.
A Judas swing occurs, sweeping buy-side liquidity consisting of local swing highs.
The ST model forms with a first displacement lower, followed by a second displacement that leaves an overlapping PD array.
A short entry is taken on the second fair value gap (the higher probability overlapping array).
The target is set strictly to a short-term liquidity pool just above the 50% equilibrium line.

examples.presenter_commentary: He emphasizes targeting equilibrium or a very close objective because in Seek and Destroy conditions, price won't run far and will likely return to the entry. He advises picking one entry model and sticking to it to avoid emotional trading.

may_differ.reason: Requires a custom Fibonacci quartile tool drawing logic on user-defined consolidation ranges.
Requires logic checking for two successive displacements in the same direction.

setup_walkthrough.what_happens: Price fails to follow through on the lows of the previous range, validating a new consolidation range. Quadrants are redrawn.
Price drops into 'discount discount'. The PM session initiates a Judas swing that sweeps a local low.
Early long entries using bullish fair value gaps fail, producing up to two potential losses.
Later in the PM session, another sweep occurs followed by an ST model leaving a small bullish FVG.
A successful long entry is taken targeting a swing high near equilibrium for a 1:2 risk-to-reward.
A secondary entry on an overlapping order block also successfully yields a 1:1.75 return.

examples.presenter_commentary: He notes that early entries can produce losses, but a 1.75 or 1:2 R return late in the day during Seek and Destroy conditions is a great result to be content with.
